selection.basis: Q00014/C00120 returned B00113 REWORK_REQUIRED because its Sonic-TV Release geometry/dimensions are not the current canonical user-HD inventory baseline. This task replaces that invalid geometry dependency with exact current inventory identities and deterministic source reacquisition/import gates. It does not repeat C-accepted semantic QA and does not reuse rejected pixel geometry.

canonical_source_policy.stock_or_sonic_release_role: semantic/orientation reconstruction prior only; never canonical construction geometry when user-HD source exists

c00120_rework_resolution.defect: B00113 reused noncanonical Sonic-TV Release dimensions/pixel geometry and its immutable material RESULT_SHA lacked the durable task record.
resolved_now: Pinned all four current canonical inventory SHA-256 identities and actual inventory canvases.
Explicitly invalidated every old Release pixel coordinate/guard/size equation for canonical production.
Verified all four canonical queue-path source files are absent on the refreshed Git HEAD, so pixel/header claims remain fail-closed.
Carried only current/C-accepted semantic occurrence counts and Total Rank -> 종합 랭크 wording.
Prepared material report and task record for one atomic producer result commit.
c00120_rework_resolution.unresolved_dependency: Exact canonical HD source bytes are not present on current Git HEAD; acquire/import bytes matching the pinned SHA-256 identities before source-effect/CLEAN_PLATE/candidate work.

material_advance.description: Creates executable source-acquisition/import gates for the four C00120-returned B00113 assets, based only on current canonical inventory identities. Future production can deterministically reject the wrong source before decode and can no longer accidentally inherit the superseded Release geometry.

reacquisition_gate: Acquire the exact canonical HD source matching canonical_sha256.
Verify exact SHA-256 before any header/pixel interpretation.
Decode and verify actual width/height/mode against current inventory; filename suffix dimensions are non-authoritative.
Determine raw/readable orientation from the acquired canonical source; do not import orientation from rejected Release geometry.
Measure effect-inclusive English bboxes and build removal/protected masks only from the acquired canonical source.
Create and independently QA CLEAN_PLATE before Korean lettering.
Derive measured v2 candidate_safe_bbox with default 2px inset; never reuse old inspection guards as final safe bboxes.
Render Korean from source parameters, measure at native resolution, refit by fresh render, then run exact English-source vs Korean-candidate proof.
Preserve DDS header/format/mips/alpha from the acquired canonical DDS at final write.
Keep runtime_validation UNTESTED until real game evidence exists.
